title: Bay Breezes: Come to Bed With Me? 8 Hours of Soft Bay Wind and Lapping Water for Sleep
description:
Come to bed with me? From the Golden Gate to the Big Sur coast in the afternoon, then back up to the Marin Headlands as the sun goes down over the bay, all slowly fading to pure black by twenty minutes so nothing lights up your room. Then it's just you, Mateo and the bay breeze for eight hours.

A soft onshore wind rising and falling through the grass and cypress, small bay water lapping at the wall, and every so often a far-off foghorn out past the bridge. No gulls, no traffic, no music, no talking. Nothing loops: every gust and every lap is generated fresh by Sandoval Studios. Photos shot along Big Sur and in the Marin Headlands.

REST. DIGEST. Goodnight.
